title: domain.invoice_number
description: Invoice number after a save that moves the invoice from previous_status to status (BE-DM-39..43). Finalizing = status finalized reached from draft, generating, open, failed or pending. Not finalizing: an existing number is kept; a blank one becomes `<prefix>-DRAFT`. Finalizing with numbering per_customer, or any self-billed invoice: `<prefix>-<customer seq %03d>-<invoice seq %03d>`. Finalizing with per_billing_entity: `<prefix>-<YYYYMM of now in the billing entity zone>-<billing-entity seq %03d>`. %03d pads with zeros to at least three digits and never truncates.

status.description: Status the invoice is saved with.

numbering.description: Numbering mode of the billing entity.

prefix.description: Document-number prefix of the BILLING ENTITY.

invoice_sequential_id.description: Per-customer invoice sequence value (when finalizing per customer or self-billed).

billing_entity_sequential_id.description: Billing-entity sequence value (when finalizing per billing entity).

number.description: Number already stored on the invoice; empty = blank.
